Subject: Re: ACTION: SouthGate — Investigate high latency / 503s (customer in production)

Quick summary of what I see after initial probes (traceroute/tcpdump/metrics):
- Between 08:40–09:10 PT we observed transient route churn on the VPC peering path carrying traffic from our us-west-2 egress cluster to SouthGate’s peering endpoints in us-west-1.
- Several flows were redirected through a stateful proxy in us-west-1 which is configured with aggressive connection-state timeouts; this caused mid-stream RSTs and aborts leading to 503s at the application layer.
- NAT gateway and connection tracking metrics show periodic spikes, not sustained exhaustion, pointing to a short-lived flap rather than capacity saturation.

I pushed a temporary mitigation at 09:30 PT: pinned SouthGate traffic for the customer’s CIDR to an alternate egress path (bypassing the affected proxy) and increased conntrack timeout for that path. Metrics after 09:35 show 503 rate dropping and tail latency improving.

Next steps (ETA):
- 1 hour: continue monitoring pinned path for stability.
- 3 hours: coordinate with infra to remove the flaky peering route and reroute at the peering table level or request peer to update their route announcement.
- Postmortem: collect full tcpdumps and route tables; will draft root cause.

Attaching initial trace: [trace-20261011.txt]
— Hannah

Subject: Exec brief — SouthGate production impact and recommended customer actions

Vivek / Evelyn — quick executive note summarizing the incident with SouthGate (10/11) so you have context for any incoming escalation.

Impact:~12% of requests to the customer’s checkout flow returned 5xx during the 08:40–09:20 PT window on 10/11. Tail latency increased by ~40% for affected calls; this caused observed checkout slowdowns and some automated retries.

Cause (preliminary): transient route churn on a VPC peering path that diverted traffic through a stateful firewall/proxy with aggressive conntrack timeouts — led to mid-stream resets and 503s. Not an application regression.

Mitigations applied: routing pin to alternate egress and increased conntrack timeout; 503s and latency improved within ~10–15 minutes of mitigation. Network team is coordinating a peering table change with the peer and will prepare a permanent reroute.

Customer ask: they want an executive-level assurance and a discussion on a one-time credit for the impact window. Recommended next steps:
- Approve Rishi/Ben to offer a goodwill credit (propose 1 month of hosted credits for affected units) pending final mitigation confirmation.
- Rishi to schedule an exec call with SouthGate leadership tomorrow morning.
- Network/Infra to deliver a short postmortem and permanent remediation timeline (48 hours).

Metrics: 503 spike lasted ~40 minutes; peak 5xx rate 12% of requests; overall request volume unchanged.

Attachments / links: [postmortem-draft-link.txt], https://dashboard.redwood.ai/requests?account=SouthGate

If you approve the customer outreach/credit, I’ll proceed and draft the exec note for the customer leadership.

— Rishi
